data.name: StarFront: Lancers
data.detailed_description:
StarFront: Lancers is an intense action space shooter where you command a wing of three customizable Heroes in challenging, high-stakes dogfights. Dive into a universe of epic space battles, collecting powerful loot and perfecting your tactical skills to survive the cold vacuum of space.

STORY CAMPAIGN: A thrilling space opera experience; an epic and cinematic sci-fi story campaign that plunges you into a universe of political intrigue and intergalactic war. Fight for survival and freedom across the solar system in a tale of heroism and betrayal.

StarFront: Lancers offers multiple ways to test your skill and strategy:

  • GAUNTLET MODE (Rogue-like): A brutal test of luck and skill. Journey across the solar system, facing escalating challenges. After each battle, you'll earn powerful buffs and new gear to aid your survival.

  • BASTION MODE (Horde Defense): Defend a vital space station against relentless, ever-increasing waves of enemy forces. Upgrade your station's defenses and fight until the last ship falls.

  • COMMANDER MODE (RTS-Like): Take tactical command of a small task force in this engaging, RTS-style game mode. Manage resources, position your units, and execute strategic maneuvers to crush the enemy fleet.

  • HERO COLLECTOR: Collect and manage a roster of unique Heroes, each tied to a distinct, unlockable ship. Level up your pilots, customize their ships with new weaponry and equipment, and define your ultimate fighting style.

  • LOOT & EQUIPMENT: Earn valuable loot, items, and high-level gear across all game modes. Use your spoils to permanently upgrade and modify your Heroes and their vessels.

  • SKILL TREE: Diversify your characters' abilities through an extensive skill tree. Invest your hard-earned skill points to unlock powerful new upgrades and new variations for their unique special abilities.

StarFront: Lancers is coming soon. The fight for the solar system awaits. Please Wishlist!
